text:
Casey Nguyen: Quick proposal 44 standard remediation card + a lightweight weekly radar. keep it 1-pager and attach to postmortems.

Casey Nguyen: Card idea (short):
```
Owner / Backup / Priority (P0/P1/P2)
ETA bucket: 7d / 30d / 90d
Ack SLA: 48h
Verification: who + smoke/canary/perf
Rollback plan
Observability changes (dash panel + alert)
Recurrence tag / pattern score
Blocked-by / Status
```

Riley Brooks: nice. can we add "Done criteria" and a "verification sign-off" field? that reduces back-and-forth when closing. :+1:

Toms Alvarez: for comms cadence: internal follow-up <48h, product sync <72h if product impacted, public status update <72h only if customers affected. weekly remediation digest in channel listing overdue items by team.

Sana Iqbal: IC rotation thought: 6-week rotation with a 3-day overlap. outgoing posts a 3-line TL;DR (active remediations, alerts, in-progress deploys). incoming must ack and pair on at least 1 hot remediation during overlap.

Casey Nguyen: agree on overlap. also want an automated "recurrence radar": tag incidents by RCA keywords, bump pattern score, auto-escalate after 3 in 90d. Toms: can you prototype the digest widget?

Toms Alvarez: yeah I'll prototype a simple widget showing overdue counts, 2+ repeats, and blocked items. can emit a weekly slack report.

Riley Brooks: volunteers: I'll draft the card + sample verification sign-off language. Sana can do the IC handoff checklist. Casey will wire the pilot plan.

Sana Iqbal: happy to draft the handoff checklist. propose checklist: access + creds, active runbooks links, open remediation cards, current alerts, pairing window time.

incident-bot: Created doc: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/remediation-card-condensed (edit: eng-oncall)

ops-bot: Poll posted: "Playbook review cadence" (weekly / biweekly / monthly). please vote.

Casey Nguyen: Plan: Riley (card + verification copy), Sana (handoff checklist), Toms (digest prototype). pilot on next postmortem. goal: reduce overdue >30d by 50% in 4 weeks. small pilot, iterate.

Riley Brooks: I'll include a small script snippet in the doc to auto-fill owner ack timestamp:
```
# on assign event
card.ack_ts = now()
notify_if_no_ack(48h)
```

Sana Iqbal: also propose a short IC handbook blurb for rotation leads: how to run the 1-week shadow, what to hand off, and quick escalation contacts. I'll include that in the playbook.

Toms Alvarez: pushing a first digest mock by Fri. will include a "heat" column so teams can triage quickly.

Casey Nguyen: thanks all. after pilot we'll run a 30-min retro: effectiveness + tweaks. if anyone wants in, ping me. :raised_hands:
